newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson's share falls, seen volatile.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson's share falls, seen volatile.

text.p: Shares in Swedish telecommunications group AB LM Ericsson fell after the company released 1996 earnings on Tuesday.
At 1220 GMT, the share was down four crowns at 248 crowns, after trading one crown below Monday's closing level before the report was released.
"People were long in the share before the report so there is no real upside," a Stockholm trader said.
"But there was nothing negative in the report and the share price could swing several times later today. We have not seen the end of it yet and there is also a press conference."
Ericsson was scheduled to hold a press conference at 1200 GMT but it was late starting due to a slight delay in the release of the earnings reports.

Ericsson reported a 33 percent rise in 1996 pre-tax profit of 10.15 billion crowns and a 26 percent rise in turnover to 124.27 billion crowns. Radio communications turnover rose to 79.1 billion crowns from 56.36 billion crowns.
